summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend testing of SENTINEL-X (Next.js). Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass covering auth (Bearer+cookie, session exchange 400/401), transactions (list, filters, live, block+persistence+audit), alerts (list, resolve, dismiss, audit), audit/stats, scan (POST target=DARK-POOL-7 returns findings+confidence, recentScans), network, users RBAC (admin list, analyst 403, admin cannot self-role-change 400, admin can change analyst role), and WebAuthn passkey options endpoints (public login/options w/ flowId, register/options requires auth). Frontend: landing/auth/dashboard/audit/network/analysis/security pages all render with expected data-testids; dashboard shows Test Admin/ADMIN HUD chip; live transaction feed BLOCK button flips status to BLOCKED; scan on /analysis returns scan-result; logout clears session (post-logout /api/auth/me = 401). WebAuthn end-to-end verified using Chromium CDP virtual authenticator (ctap2/internal/UV): passkey register on /security produced success message + passkey-item, then cookie-cleared /auth biometric-login-btn authenticated and landed on /dashboard.
seed_data_creation: Created transient ANALYST user + session in test_database via mongosh for RBAC tests (auto-cleaned in fixture teardown). Also seeded a WebAuthn passkey for test-admin-001 during frontend run; this persists in the passkeys collection (not cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Scan endpoint wraps result in {data:{findings,confidence,...}, model, timestamp}. Network endpoint returns {gateways:[...]}. WebAuthn virtual-authenticator flow works end-to-end when created via CDP AFTER cookie is set but BEFORE navigating to /security. Note: the seeded admin passkey from prior run may still exist in DB; if you want a clean biometric-error test, first delete passkeys for test-admin-001. All 4 [error] console entries during the run are benign expected 401s from /api/auth/me on /auth and post-logout.
